definition: a small tropical fish kept in tanks
description: A cosy living room in the evening. A young woman with dark curly hair in a cream knit sweater leans close to a lit aquarium and purses her lips like a fish. A black fish with a large sail-like fin and tail swims up to the glass until it is face to face with her. Smaller silver-white fish swim among green plants and driftwood, and food flakes float at the surface. A fish net and a tub of fish food lie on the cabinet, and a cat sleeps on the sofa behind her.

taps.phrase: to show off its huge fin

de.answer: Sie spitzt die Lippen wie ein Fisch.
